stack_batch_tensors: stack a list of tensors into a batch with right-bottom padding to a divisible size
detect_anomalous_params: detect model parameters that require grad but are not in the loss computational graph
merge_dict_losses: merge multiple loss dictionaries into one while keeping torch.fx symbolic trace compatible

revert_sync_batchnorm: convert all SyncBatchNorm layers in a model back to regular BatchNormXd layers
